name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
description: Exploit a weakness in an internet-facing application to gain initial network access.

name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
description: Abuse command or script interpreters to execute commands, scripts, or binaries.

name: Valid Accounts
tactic: Initial Access, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, Defense Evasion
description: Abuse existing valid accounts to gain or maintain access and bypass access controls.

name: Scheduled Task/Job
description: Abuse task scheduling mechanisms to run code at a specified time or on a recurring basis.

name: Account Manipulation
description: Modify an account to preserve access or gain additional roles, permissions, or privileges.

name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism
description: Circumvent mechanisms designed to control elevation and gain higher-level permissions.

name: Impair Defenses
description: Disable or modify security tools and controls to avoid detection.

name: Unsecured Credentials
description: Search compromised systems for credentials stored in insecure locations.

name: Account Discovery
description: Enumerate valid accounts, usernames, or email addresses in an environment.

name: Network Service Discovery
description: Identify services running on remote hosts and network infrastructure.

name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution
description: Configure a system to automatically execute a program during boot or user logon.

name: OS Credential Dumping
description: Extract account credentials from operating-system caches, memory, or structures.

name: Remote Services
description: Use remote services and valid accounts to access other systems during lateral movement.

name: Archive Collected Data
description: Compress or encrypt collected data before exfiltration.

name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
description: Send stolen data over an existing command-and-control communication channel.

name: Data Encrypted for Impact
description: Encrypt data on target systems to interrupt access to system or network resources.

name: Brute Force
description: Repeatedly guess credentials to gain access to accounts.

name: Automated Collection
description: Use automated techniques to collect internal data matching selected criteria.

name: Data from Cloud Storage
description: Access data stored in cloud object storage or cloud-based document services.

name: Process Injection
description: Execute code in the address space of a separate live process.

name: Use Alternate Authentication Material
description: Use alternate authentication material to access systems or services.

name: Escape to Host
description: Break out of a container to access the underlying host.

name: Data from Information Repositories
description: Search and collect information from data repositories such as databases and collaboration platforms.

name: Application Layer Protocol
description: Use application-layer protocols to communicate with remote systems.
